title: Why I Chose Svelte for Building a High-Performance, Heavy-Interaction Game HUD
excerpt: Building an in-game HUD overlay means balancing heavy interactivity with native performance. After starting with Vanilla JavaScript and exploring Lit, I chose Svelte for our engine-agnostic HUD. Here is why Svelte won—from zero-VDOM speed and effortless transitions to declarative Payline grids and untouched developer contracts.
